records.detail: 39 advisories (CVE-2026-96636..96644, CVE-2026-96778, CVE-2026-112390..112406 (no 112398), CVE-2026-112891..112902, GHSA-78g4-xqwv-q3g8), all from uv.lock, the contributor path (uv sync --dev). Every documented user install (installer script, uv tool install, pipx, pip) resolves the pyproject floor pillow>=11.0 fresh: pip-audit got 13.0.0, clean. On the lock path the read tool is the only Pillow caller, behind a magic-byte allowlist (JPEG, static PNG, GIF, WebP, header-checked BMP), so the TIFF/EPS/PDF/XBM/APNG decoders never receive data; GIF/BMP/JPEG paths remain.
CVE-2026-63374 (critical), CVE-2026-64847 (medium). Lock path only; a fresh install resolves anyio>=4.0 to 4.15.1.
GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2 (critical, CA bundle). Transitive via httpx; lock path only, a fresh install gets 2026.10.23. Dependabot covers github-actions only, so no automated uv.lock refresh exists.
requires-python >=3.12; importlib.resources is the stdlib API on every supported version (catalog_loader.py:10, models_dev.py:7, tui/themes/__init__.py:13).

scripts/generate_models.py:26, a maintainer build script for the model catalog. _load_source hands only http(s) locations to urlopen, so file:// never reaches it; the location is the maintainer's CLI argument or a hardcoded catalog URL, and the line carries a reviewed noqa: S310.
